blk_introduction.text: Puyo is a Japanese puzzle game series where round colored blobs fall, join in groups of four, and pop. Compile made the first game in 1991, Sega took over the series in 1998, and later hits like Puyo Puyo Fever and Puyo Puyo Tetris kept it popular.

blk_part_02_part_2_how_play_works.text: When Puyo pop, the Puyo above them fall down. If those falling Puyo make a new group of four, they pop too. This is called a chain. A long chain sends garbage to the other player. Garbage Puyo, called Ojama in Japanese, are gray blobs that do not pop by themselves. You win when the other player's board fills up to the top of the third column from the left.
